The current implementation uses string concatenation to build SQL queries.
I need to replace this with `PreparedStatement` to prevent SQL injection and ensure the business rules defined in `CustomerDirectory` are followed.

- Name/City: Any characters.
- Amounts: "one to eighteen ASCII digits and nothing else". Null or other text throws `IllegalArgumentException`.
- `searchByNamePrefix`: prefix matches everybody if empty. `%` and `_` are ordinary characters. Case-insensitive.
- `list`: Sort keys must be exactly `id`, `name`, `city`, or `balance`. Ties are ordered by `id` ASC.
- `findByIds`: Ids must be valid. Empty list is empty result.
- `sameCityAs`: Customer ID must exist, otherwise `IllegalArgumentException`.

2. `findByName`: uses `quote()`.
3. `searchByNamePrefix`: uses `UPPER(name) LIKE UPPER('prefix%')`. This is vulnerable to SQL injection and doesn't handle `%` or `_` as literals.

```java
package com.rustyvault.legacy;

import com.rustyvault.CustomerDirectory;

import java.sql.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class LegacyCustomerDirectory implements CustomerDirectory {

    private static final String COLUMNS = "id, name, city, balance_cents";
    private static final Pattern DIGITS_ONLY = Pattern.compile("^[0-9]{1,18}$");
    private final Connection conn;

    public LegacyCustomerDirectory(Connection conn) {
        this.conn = conn;
    }

    private void validateId(String id) {
        if (id == null || !DIGITS_ONLY.matcher(id).matches()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid ID");
        }
    }

    private void validateAmount(String amount) {
        if (amount == null || !DIGITS_ONLY.matcher(amount).matches()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid amount");
        }
    }

    public long addCustomer(String name, String city, long balanceCents) {
        if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty() || city == null || city.trim().isEmpty() || balanceCents < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID CUSTOMER");
        }
        String sql = "INSERT INTO customer (name, city, balance_cents) VALUES (?, ?, ?)";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {
            ps.setString(1, name);
            ps.setString(2, city);
            ps.setLong(3, balanceCents);
            ps.executeUpdate();
            try (ResultSet keys = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                if (keys.next()) {
                    return keys.getLong(1);
                }
                throw new IllegalStateException("Failed to retrieve generated ID");
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SQL ERROR: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public List<String> findByName(String name) {
        if (name == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID NAME");
        }
        String sql = "SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM customer WHERE name = ? ORDER BY id";
        return query(sql, name);
    }

    public List<String> searchByNamePrefix(String prefix) {
        if (prefix == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID PREFIX");
        }
        // Escape % and _ for LIKE
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : prefix.toCharArray()) {
            if (c == '%' || c == '_') {
                sb.append('\\');
            }
            sb.append(c);
        }
        sb.append('%');
        String pattern = sb.toString();
        String sql = "SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM customer WHERE UPPER(name) LIKE UPPER(?) ESCAPE '\\' ORDER BY id";
        return query(sql, pattern);
    }

    public List<String> list(String sortBy, boolean descending) {
        Map<String, String> allowed = Map.of(
            "id", "id",
            "name", "name",
            "city", "city",
            "balance", "balance_cents"
        );
        String column = allowed.get(sortBy);
        if (column == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid sort key");
        }
        String sql = "SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM customer ORDER BY " + column
                + (descending ? " DESC" : " ASC") + ", id ASC";
        return query(sql);
    }

    public String getById(String id) {
        validateId(id);
        String sql = "SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM customer WHERE id = ?";
        List<String> rows = query(sql, id);
        return rows.isEmpty() ? null : rows.get(0);
    }

    public List<String> findByIds(List<String> ids) {
        if (ids == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("IDs list cannot be null");
        }
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }
        for (String id : ids) {
            validateId(id);
        }
        
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder("SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM customer WHERE id IN (");
        for (int i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {
            sql.append("?");
            if (i < ids.size() - 1) {
                sql.append(",");
            }
        }
        sql.append(") ORDER BY id");

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {
            for (int i = 0; i < ids.size(); i++) {
                ps.setLong(i + 1, Long.parseLong(ids.get(i)));
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return resultSetToList(rs);
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SQL ERROR: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public List<String> richerThan(String minBalanceCents) {
        validateAmount(minBalanceCents);
        String sql = "SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM customer WHERE balance_cents > ? ORDER BY id";
        return query(sql, minBalanceCents);
    }

    public List<String> sameCityAs(String id) {
        validateId(id);
        String row = getById(id);
        if (row == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("UNKNOWN CUSTOMER: " + id);
        }
        String city = row.split("\\|")[2];
        String sql = "SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM customer WHERE city = ? AND id <> ? ORDER BY id";
        return query(sql, city, id);
    }

    public int deleteByCity(String city) {
        if (city == null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("INVALID CITY");
        }
        String sql = "DELETE FROM customer WHERE city = ?";
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setString(1, city);
            return ps.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SQL ERROR: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    public int count() {
        String sql = "SELECT count(*) FROM customer";
        try (Statement st = conn.createStatement();
             ResultSet rs = st.executeQuery(sql)) {
            if (rs.next()) {
                return rs.getInt(1);
            }
            return 0;
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SQL ERROR: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private List<String> query(String sql, Object... params) {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < params.length; i++) {
                ps.setObject(i + 1, params[i]);
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return resultSetToList(rs);
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("SQL ERROR: " + e.getMessage());
        }
    }

    private List<String> query(String sql) {
        return query(sql);
    }

    private List<String> resultSetToList(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        List<String> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        while (rs.next()) {
            rows.add(rs.getLong(1) + "|" + rs.getString(2) + "|" + rs.getString(3) + "|"
                    + rs.getLong(4));
        }
        return rows;
    }
}
```
